summary: Flatpak enters AUZiX as a post-Podman external app provider, not as permission for /usr, /lib, /bin, /etc, /var, or /tmp to return to the base image.
evidence: AUZiX VM135 proved Podman, BusyBox, Nginx, Alpine, and ext4 functional tests before this lane
packages/flatpak-desktop.queue.json orders Bubblewrap, OSTree, xdg-dbus-proxy, Flatpak, and a Firefox adapter
scripts/test-auzix-pruned-root.sh already proves an imported runtime can start with /bin, /usr, /lib, and /lib64 removed
decision: Use BKC to run the strict-path proof before building Flatpak. The stripped ISO should add /System/Compatibility links back only as named break-fix debt after a failing proof.
anti_patterns: Do not call a donor package ready because its Debian layout works under /usr.
Do not add broad root-level compatibility links to make Flatpak pass without a receipt.
Do not rebuild the install ISO with legacy links restored by default.
